buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Dear Seller, You are requested to submit all the necessary documents required for the bid, including the MAF (Manufac turer Authorization Form) and Technical Compliance Statement, duly signed and stamped by the OEM on t heir official letterhead. Please ensure that all other documents as specified in the bid requirements are also submitted properly a nd within the stipulated timeline to avoid any issues during bid evaluation. Terms and Conditions

1) Scope includes supply, installation and configuration of Laptops, . 2) Agency should have REGISTERED OFFICE IN THE UT AND sufficient manpower in consignee State/UT t o address after sales service related Issue, contact detail & address should be submitted along with quote. 3) Service Centre Detail of OEM in consignee location & Toll Free Number should be submitted along with q uote. 4) Bidder should have submitted Bid specific authorization certificate from OEM, Bid Number, Bidder Name & Address must be mentioned in MAF Document. 5) The bidder should have executed similar nature of work in Govt Sect in Consignee State/UT. 6) Data sheet of offered product must be attached with comply of asked specification. 7) The bidder and OEM both should not be debarred/ restrained/ blacklisted by any Central Govt. / State G ovt. agency/Autonomous body of the Central or State Govt./PSU/ any university or Institute etc. in the past for similar works. Affidavit by Bidder to that effect must be attached. 8) Bidders offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload and physically submit EMD in shape of DD befor e end date of bid. 9) Any corrigendum to this tender will be notified through the aforesaid websites only. The committee rese rves the right to accept or reject any or all the bids without assigning any reason thereof at any stage. 10) The supply, transportation, installation etc. of the items shall be sole responsibility and at the risk of th e firm till the acceptance by the Deptt. 11) OEM should be present in the TOP 4 No's as per latest IDC report. Product compliance sheet must be attached on OEM Letter head . 12) OEM Authorization:- Bidder should have Bid specific inked sign Authorization of each product and shall be submitted along with the Technical Bid with Name, mail id and phone no. & inked sign to ensure the au thenticity of the authorization given by the OEM of the offered product. NOTE:- Any seller/vendor who submit incomplete bid, including non submission or non furnishing of requisi te documents/EMD, /Conditional bids/deviation of terms and conditions or scope of work/incorrect informati on in bid will be rejected/disqualified immediately without any further clarifications. . 2. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 3. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of

CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 4. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 5. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 6. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 7. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid.
